warnings: Budget Tier Compromise: Alice prefers a medium budget (Tier 2) while Bob prefers a high budget (Tier 3). Accommodations and dining have been balanced in the comfortable mid-to-upscale range (Tier 2.5), using high-quality boutique 4-star hotels with private amenities, while keeping daily expenses reasonable.

Morning Routine Compromise: Alice prefers an early start (6:00 AM - 8:00 AM) while Bob prefers a late start (10:00 AM - 12:00 PM). The itinerary adopts a gentle midway schedule (activities starting around 9:00 AM - 9:30 AM), allowing Alice leisurely mornings or quiet walks while Bob enjoys extra rest.
